verdict.line: You win the trades from level 3 through 5 before his Q is up again, but you lose the lane if you're still near half health when he hits 6 with Ignite.

brief.thesis: Irelia only has a real answer to Garen's all-in kit through W (Defiant Dance), which reduces physical damage while it charges — that's your entire counter to his Q (Decisive Strike) auto-reset and E (Judgment) spin damage. Garen has no way to interact with your E (Flawless Duet) stun at range, so your engage window exists whenever his Q is down, but the 44.6% win rate over 1145 games says most Irelias misjudge post-6 all-ins and die to Demacian Justice plus Ignite instead of resetting the trade with Q (Bladesurge).

theirWindow.what: Garen can silence you with Q, spin E, and threaten Demacian Justice plus Ignite for a true-damage execute. Back off from trades the moment you're low post-6 — his R's 400 range means walking distance matters.

yourWindow.when: his Q (8s cooldown) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Without Q's silence and move speed burst, Garen can't punish your E stun or catch your Q (Bladesurge) reset. Open with E to Mark and stun, follow with Q for the dash-heal, and W-charge into his E spin to blunt the damage.

start.why: The 44.8% win rate over 1271 games backs this as the standard start — the extra HP and sustain from the potion covers the poke you'll eat from his E while you look for E-Q trade windows.

boots.why: 85.6% pick rate and the higher win rate (44% vs Mercury's Treads' 51.5% sample) — the flat damage reduction directly counters his auto-attack-heavy E spin and Q empowered strike.

core.why: Current-health damage and the attack speed slow punish Garen's healthy passive regen and let you keep pace in extended trades.
Highest-picked second item (24.6% and 21% paths both build through it) — the split-push and health scaling suit a lane where you're not always forcing all-ins.
Damage reduction over time turns his burst-heavy Q-E-R combo into manageable ticks instead of a spike.

situational.when: he's building tanky and you need magic resist to survive his E spin longer
you're ahead and want to close out fights faster instead of outlasting him
his R (Demacian Justice) is threatening to one-shot you post-6 and you need to play riskier for objectives

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks fastest through your E-Q trade pattern and gives the sustain you need to out-trade his Perseverance regen once stacks are up.

summoners.why: 82.2% pick rate on this combo — Ignite matters directly against Perseverance, cutting his passive regen exactly when you're trying to force a kill before his own Ignite comes back.

playing.title: Trade only after tracking his Q
playing.detail: Decisive Strike is an 8-second cooldown that breaks slows and silences on hit — engaging into it means eating a silence mid-combo. Wait for it to go on cooldown before committing E.

playing.title: Lead with E, not Q
playing.detail: E (Flawless Duet) converges two blades that stun and Mark anything caught between them. Landing it first guarantees your follow-up Q (Bladesurge) refreshes on the Marked target.

playing.title: Charge W into his E spin
playing.detail: W (Defiant Dance) deals more damage the longer it charges and reduces physical damage taken while charging — time it to eat his Judgment spin instead of trading autos into it raw.

playing.title: Play passive from level 6 until you have Ignite parity
playing.detail: Demacian Justice executes based on missing health with up to a 140-second cooldown at rank 1. Don't sit at half HP near his 400-range threat zone until your own Ignite is back up.

playing.title: Use passive stacks to decide all-ins
playing.detail: Ionian Fervor's bonus attack speed and on-hit damage at max stacks is your all-in signal — don't commit to a full trade until you've built stacks through Q or E hits first.

playing.title: Punish backline base timers
playing.detail: His Perseverance regen turns off the moment he takes damage. Poke with Q before he can top off between trades so he's forced to fight from a deficit.

playing.title: Reset with Q on kill or Mark
playing.detail: Bladesurge's cooldown refreshes entirely if the target is Marked or dies — chain this off your E Mark to stay on top of him through an extended fight.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the trade timing, cooldown interactions, and power-spike reasoning are my own tactical read.

stats.opponentTip: Absorb Garen’s damage with a well-timed [W]. Be careful of Garen’s (R) + Ignite when he reaches level 6, and try to engage to your advantage using [P] stacks.
